primary_sources.author: Hendrik Bosma
primary_sources.visual_review: bosma_p81.png rendered with bundled pdftoppm and inspected
primary_sources.finding: Characteristic noise-temperature eigenvalues and simultaneous mode diagonalization are established prior art; do not claim the alarm core as new.

primary_sources.title: Noise waves and passive linear multiports
primary_sources.retrieved_range: Author-repository abstract, web lines 18-20; publication metadata lines 91-121
primary_sources.finding: Relates passive-network noise covariance to scattering using equilibrium with reflectionless terminations. Current proof reconstructs C=T(I-SSdagger) from that equilibrium contract.
primary_sources.full_pdf: Web download redirected to expired signed URL; full PDF not used as an inspected premise.

primary_sources.title: Representation of a Noisy Transmission Line
primary_sources.finding: Independent local noise is transported by a covariance congruence integral and depends linearly on temperature. DC excess noise and long-range spatial correlations are excluded.
primary_sources.scope_note: Do not use its equation (15) as a proof of matched-line left/right cancellation; current matched-limit proof uses local passive FDT independently.
